subject: E-Commerce
title: Embedded Commerce Everywhere
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Embedded Commerce Everywhere.

hook.text: Your Samsung fridge can reorder milk when it detects you're running low.

buildup.text: IoT devices—fridges, washing machines, cars—detect when you need products and offer to reorder automatically.

discovery.text: HP Instant Ink detects low printer ink and ships replacements before you notice. Replenishment becomes invisible.

twist.text: Embedded commerce creates vendor lock-in. Your HP printer orders HP ink.

climax.text: When objects buy for you, convenience is total but choice disappears. The device picks the vendor, not you.

punchline.text: Fridge reorders milk, printer reorders ink. When objects shop for us, they.

quiz.question: What is the main concern with embedded commerce in IoT devices?
options: Devices create vendor lock-in by automatically ordering from partnered brands only
